_comment: Routing table for the postmark-inbound-filer agent. Maps the ORIGINAL sender's client domain (parsed from the forwarded email body, NOT the colin@ignitemarketing.com forwarding envelope) to a ClickUp List. Seeded 2026-06-14 from the live workspace + brain note 'ClickUp workspace map (2026-06-13)'. Update as clients change. team_id is the ClickUp workspace/team id.
_sentry_note: Sentry is intentionally NOT whitelisted for email→ClickUp: the jdmbuysell-sentry-triage Worker already files richer, AI-diagnosed, deduped tasks for jdmbuysell-v4-web. Future plan: centralize Sentry→ClickUp as an org-wide API/webhook service (replacing the in-repo worker) rather than via email.
_from_domain_routing_note: The CF Worker (inbound-worker/) NOW ALSO routes a DIRECT send (no forwarded original sender in body) by its From-header domain when that domain is a known client in domain_to_list AND not a forwarder domain (colingreig.com/.ca, ignitemarketing.com). e.g. info@jdmbuysell.com digests -> jdm list. SOURCE OF TRUTH for the Worker's routing.js copy.
_allowed_sender_note: Security gate enforced by postmark_inbound_gate.py: an inbound email is only processed if its From-header domain (the forwarder/sender that hit hermes@) is one of these, or a subdomain of one. Everything else is marked ignored and never wakes the filer agent. This is defense-in-depth on top of the M365 distribution list's 'require authenticated senders' (which already blocks external mail to hermes@).
